title: Plant-Based Mojo 'Chicken' Tacos
subtitle: with Sunshine Salsa and Mashed Avo
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you’re vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Check your avocado is ripe before starting this recipe. Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Finely grate the orange zest. Slice off the top and bottom of the orange. Following the curve of the orange, slice the skin from the flesh. Remove any remaining pith. Holding the orange over a bowl, cut between the membranes to segment the orange. Finely chop the onion (see Kitchen notes).
Warm tortillas: Enclose the tortillas in foil and put in the oven for 8 mins or until softened and warmed through.

Cook chicken-style strips: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken-style strips, stirring occasionally, for 3-4 mins until browned and warmed through. Scatter over half the Tex-Mex seasoning and toss to combine. Remove the pan from the heat.

Make salsa: Coarsely chop the coriander, discarding the stems. Add the coriander, orange zest, orange segments, onion and 1 tsp white wine vinegar to the orange juice. Season with salt and pepper and toss to combine.

Serve up: Coarsely mash the avocado in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Combine the remaining Tex-Mex seasoning, 2 tbs vegan mayonnaise (see Kitchen notes) and 1 tsp water in a bowl. Divide the chicken-style strips, salsa and avo among the tortillas. Drizzle with the Tex-Mex mayo and enjoy!

Kitchen notes: Not a fan of raw onion? Instead of adding it to the salsa, cook the onion in the frypan for 2 mins before adding the chicken-style strips in Step 3. ~ If you don't follow a vegan diet, feel free to use whichever mayo you have on hand.
